description.value:
Duration constant

When a creature fails — but does not critically fail — a saving throw against a Verse of yours that imposes a condition restricting its actions or movement, that effect lasts 1 round longer than it otherwise would. This applies to one such effect per casting and does not extend an effect that was already extended.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element conditionally extends an already-applied condition's duration based on the degree of success that created it; searched AdjustDegreeOfSuccess (evaluated pre-roll, can't react to the roll's own outcome to extend a duration) and ItemAlteration (no duration-extension property) -- neither fits.
